name: Bridge Sampling
definition: A method for sampling a subpath (bridge) of arbitrary vertex count connecting two vertices (endpoints). The probability density of the sampled bridge is proportional to all phase functions at inner vertices and reciprocal squared distance terms (geometry terms).
summary: Bridge Sampling connects two vertices in a participating medium by rotating and uniformly scaling a preliminary path, preserving angles and handling forward scattering more robustly than sibling methods.
